body:
Etymology 1

From Robot , from a English language, ultimately related to Etymology 2, below.

Etymology 2

robot , from robota . in the play after having been suggested to him by his brother . Largely displaced .

Ultimately a cognate with from , and see dialectal English . . Related to orphan , but with a -t- suffix from - instead of the -an- from .

Compare and , sometimes mistakenly cited as the direct source of the English word.

Etymology 3

Referencing the origin of the name of the imageboard (created in 2008), so-called because it implements the algorithm by to prevent the reposting of content.

Possibly overlapping with the sense of robot , alluding to , due to the prevalence of personal stories describing awkward or embarrassing situations on the board.
